scope: All 18 remaining listings added by PRs #13 and #22 after the two Composio exclusions in PR #23; 17 individual skills and one skill repository.
method: Read each pinned instruction or repository README, repository licence grants, applicable documentation licences, notices and relevant skill/ancestor licensing files. Inspected complete recursive Git trees for eleven repositories; Azure-Sentinel used its complete root tree and complete .github subtree because the whole-repository recursive response was unavailable. Publisher files were treated as review data.
validation_boundary: Published instruction and code terms only. No publisher skill execution, installation, hosted service access, account operation or runtime evaluation. Third-party services and tools keep their own terms.
